facts.business: Royal Sense Limited is a healthcare company specializing in medical device and pharmaceutical trading, offering branded generics, specialty drugs, OTC medicines, biologics, biosimilars, diagnostic devices, surgical consumables, and nebulizers to hospitals, clinics, diagnostic laboratories, and government institutions across India.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Expand its domestic and global distribution network
Launch new therapeutic and diagnostic products
Explore strategic alliances and partnerships to strengthen its supply chain and technology base
Continue enhancing its regulatory capabilities to penetrate regulated international markets
